task.question: What is the name of the person known as Tinned Fish Reviews?
task.evidence: Can do | In keeping with the tinned fish theme, Marcus Ansell – known to his millions of Instagram, YouTube and TikTok followers as Tinned Fish Reviews and usually found wearing a fez – opens, decants and taste tests cans of fish. Calm to the extreme, even when appalled or ecstatic about the contents of the tin, he is a joy to watch and learn from. As is his dog, King Arthur.
task.page: Why we’re all hooked on tinned fish

answer: The person known as Tinned Fish Reviews is Alexandra S. FINAL: Alexandra S.
